# Roots Tunisia

> Tunisian genealogy platform for family trees, civil registers, Archives Nationales de Tunisie, beylical and Ottoman sijillat, habous deeds, Protectorate records, oral history, and an interactive map of the 24 governorates.

## Site
- Home: https://rootstunisia.com/
- About: https://rootstunisia.com/about
- Interactive map: https://rootstunisia.com/interactive-map
- Historical periods: https://rootstunisia.com/periods
- Sources & archives: https://rootstunisia.com/sources
- Services: https://rootstunisia.com/services
- Family trees: https://rootstunisia.com/gallery/trees
- Photo gallery: https://rootstunisia.com/gallery/images
- Manuscripts & books: https://rootstunisia.com/gallery/books
- Oral history / audio: https://rootstunisia.com/gallery/audios
- Documents: https://rootstunisia.com/gallery/documents
- Articles: https://rootstunisia.com/articles
- Subscriptions: https://rootstunisia.com/subscriptions
- Help center: https://rootstunisia.com/help-center
- Contact: https://rootstunisia.com/contact

## Geography
- Country: Tunisia (TN)
- Focus: Grand Tunis, Cap Bon, Sahel, Kairouan, Jérid, Djerba, Dahar, Tell, Hautes Steppes
- Coordinates (Tunis): 36.8065, 10.1815

## Primary topics
Tunisian genealogy, family trees, Archives Nationales de Tunisie, Majba registers, habous / waqf ahlī, Protectorate état civil, CADN / ANOM, Antenati Italian diaspora, Maltese parish records, Jewish Tunisian archives, tribal territories, governorate dossiers, paleography and certified transcriptions.
